m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Verify handoff is complete: task=regen 16 record pairs + diagnostic repro, intent=inference-only baseline measurement, scope=diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py RECORDS_DIR env-var + .agent-work records/evidence, exclusions=no retrain/src changes/param edits, evidence=g1_baseline_repro.txt + numbers in tolerance, stop conditions=pass >10min or out-of-tolerance repro. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff complete: task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, stop conditions all present
postconditions.satisfied_by: Handoff complete: all required sections present

m1-env-var-edit.title: Add RECORDS_DIR env-var override to diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py
m1-env-var-edit.imperative: Replace the RECORDS_DIR assignment on line 57 with an os.environ.get override (add import os if missing). Default must remain the issue-381-same-pairs path. EVIDENCE_DIR optionally overridable too. No other behavior change.

postconditions.statement: scripts/diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py imports os and RECORDS_DIR uses os.environ.get; default unchanged

check.command: py -c "import ast, pathlib; src=pathlib.Path('scripts/diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py').read_text(); assert 'import os' in src and 'QUALI_SAME_PAIRS_RECORDS_DIR' in src, 'env-var override missing'"

constraints: Minimal edit: only RECORDS_DIR (and optionally EVIDENCE_DIR) assignment lines
No other behavior, math, or output changes

payload.cmd: py -c "import ast, pathlib; src=pathlib.Path('scripts/diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py').read_text(); assert 'import os' in src and 'QUALI_SAME_PAIRS_RECORDS_DIR' in src, 'env-var override missing'"

m2-regen-rw.title: Regenerate race_weekend records for all years 2018-2025
m2-regen-rw.imperative: Run backtest-latent-power-module for driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend, years 2018-2025, emitting records to .agent-work/issue-414-quali-head-scoping/records/rw_YEAR.json. Each pass ~70s; abort if >10min.

postconditions.statement: All 8 rw_YEAR.record.json files present under records/

check.command: py -c "from pathlib import Path; r=Path('.agent-work/issue-414-quali-head-scoping/records'); missing=[y for y in range(2018,2026) if not (r/f'rw_{y}.record.json').exists()]; assert not missing, f'Missing rw records: {missing}'"

m3-regen-rh.title: Regenerate recent_history records for all years 2018-2025
m3-regen-rh.imperative: Run backtest-latent-power-module for driver_quali_power_from_recent_history, years 2018-2025, emitting records to .agent-work/issue-414-quali-head-scoping/records/rh_YEAR.json. No --compound-prior-root. Each pass ~70s; abort if >10min.

postconditions.statement: All 8 rh_YEAR.record.json files present under records/

check.command: py -c "from pathlib import Path; r=Path('.agent-work/issue-414-quali-head-scoping/records'); missing=[y for y in range(2018,2026) if not (r/f'rh_{y}.record.json').exists()]; assert not missing, f'Missing rh records: {missing}'"

m4-run-diagnostic.title: Run diagnostic against 414 records and capture stdout
m4-run-diagnostic.imperative: Set QUALI_SAME_PAIRS_RECORDS_DIR to the 414 records path. Run diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py. Capture full stdout to .agent-work/issue-414-quali-head-scoping/evidence/g1_baseline_repro.txt.

postconditions.statement: Evidence file g1_baseline_repro.txt exists and is non-empty

check.command: py -c "from pathlib import Path; f=Path('.agent-work/issue-414-quali-head-scoping/evidence/g1_baseline_repro.txt'); assert f.exists() and f.stat().st_size > 0, 'evidence file missing or empty'"

m5-verify-evidence.title: Verify reproduced numbers within tolerance and confirm git status
m5-verify-evidence.imperative: Parse the captured output for headline rw/rh/ceiling numbers and EASY-band figures. Confirm they land within specified tolerances. Run git status --short. Confirm no params/ or src/ behavior file changed.

postconditions.statement: Numbers within tolerance; git status shows only diagnostic script edit; no params/src changes

constraints: STOP and report if numbers out of tolerance
Do not fix diagnostic to force a match
